examples.hanzi: 农民们在地里忙着收麦子。
examples.pinyin: Nóngmínmen zài dì lǐ mángzhe shōu màizi.
examples.english: The farmers are busy harvesting wheat in the fields.

examples.hanzi: 政府给农民发放了新的补贴。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ gěi nóngmín fāfàng le xīn de bǔtiē.
examples.english: The government gave farmers new subsidies.

examples.hanzi: 这个万能充电器可以给各种手机充电。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wànnéng chōngdiànqì kěyǐ gěi gè zhǒng shǒujī chōngdiàn.
examples.english: This universal charger can charge all kinds of phones.

examples.hanzi: 没有人是万能的，大家都需要帮助。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén shì wànnéng de, dàjiā dōu xūyào bāngzhù.
examples.english: No one is all-powerful; everybody needs help.

examples.hanzi: 我万分感谢你的帮助。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wànfēn gǎnxiè nǐ de bāngzhù.
examples.english: I am extremely grateful for your help.

examples.hanzi: 她对这次误会感到万分抱歉。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zhè cì wùhuì gǎndào wànfēn bàoqiàn.
examples.english: She felt extremely sorry about this misunderstanding.

examples.hanzi: 这支口红的颜色很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī kǒuhóng de yánsè hěn piàoliang.
examples.english: The color of this lipstick is very pretty.

examples.hanzi: 妈妈送了我一支口红做生日礼物。
examples.pinyin: Māma sòng le wǒ yì zhī kǒuhóng zuò shēngrì lǐwù.
examples.english: Mom gave me a lipstick as a birthday present.

examples.hanzi: 这件事需要各部门之间好好协调。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì xūyào gè bùmén zhījiān hǎohāo xiétiáo.
examples.english: This matter requires good coordination between departments.

examples.hanzi: 他的动作很协调，跳舞跳得非常好。
examples.pinyin: Tā de dòngzuò hěn xiétiáo, tiàowǔ tiào de fēicháng hǎo.
examples.english: His movements are well coordinated, and he dances very well.

examples.hanzi: 这位皇帝在位时间很长。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi huángdì zàiwèi shíjiān hěn cháng.
examples.english: This emperor reigned for a long time.

examples.hanzi: 故宫是古代皇帝住的地方。
examples.pinyin: Gùgōng shì gǔdài huángdì zhù de dìfang.
examples.english: The Forbidden City is where ancient emperors lived.

examples.hanzi: 为了赶报告，他整夜没有休息。
examples.pinyin: Wèile gǎn bàogào, tā zhěngyè méiyǒu xiūxi.
examples.english: To finish the report, he didn't rest all night.

examples.hanzi: 外面整夜都在下雨。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn zhěngyè dōu zài xià yǔ.
examples.english: It rained all night outside.

examples.hanzi: 我们叫了一个大比萨，大家一起分着吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiào le yí gè dà bǐsà, dàjiā yìqǐ fēnzhe chī.
examples.english: We ordered a big pizza and shared it.

examples.hanzi: 这家店的比萨饼皮很薄。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de bǐsà bǐngpí hěn báo.
examples.english: The crust of this shop's pizza is very thin.

examples.hanzi: 今夜有雨，别忘了关窗。
examples.pinyin: Jīnyè yǒu yǔ, bié wàng le guān chuāng.
examples.english: It will rain tonight, so don't forget to close the window.

examples.hanzi: 今夜我们一起看星星吧。
examples.pinyin: Jīnyè wǒmen yìqǐ kàn xīngxing ba.
examples.english: Let's watch the stars together tonight.

examples.hanzi: 他想用钱收买这位证人。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng yòng qián shōumǎi zhè wèi zhèngrén.
examples.english: He wants to buy off this witness with money.

examples.hanzi: 他们用小礼物收买了人心。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yòng xiǎo lǐwù shōumǎi le rénxīn.
examples.english: They won people over with small gifts.

examples.hanzi: 他今天外出办事，下午才回来。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān wàichū bànshì, xiàwǔ cái huílái.
examples.english: He is out on business today and will be back in the afternoon.

examples.hanzi: 外出旅行时，请带好证件。
examples.pinyin: Wàichū lǚxíng shí, qǐng dài hǎo zhèngjiàn.
examples.english: When traveling, please bring your ID.

examples.hanzi: 凯撒是罗马历史上很重要的人物。
examples.pinyin: Kǎisā shì Luómǎ lìshǐ shàng hěn zhòngyào de rénwù.
examples.english: Caesar is a very important figure in Roman history.

examples.hanzi: 他点了一份凯撒沙拉。
examples.pinyin: Tā diǎn le yí fèn Kǎisā shālā.
examples.english: He ordered a Caesar salad.

examples.hanzi: 这个项目的代号是“蓝鸟”。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de dàihào shì "lánniǎo".
examples.english: This project's code name is "Bluebird".

examples.hanzi: 在游戏里，我的代号是“小白”。
examples.pinyin: Zài yóuxì lǐ, wǒ de dàihào shì "xiǎo bái".
examples.english: In the game, my code name is "Xiaobai".

examples.hanzi: 他吃了镇静剂，很快就睡着了。
examples.pinyin: Tā chī le zhènjìngjì, hěn kuài jiù shuìzháo le.
examples.english: He took a sedative and fell asleep soon.

examples.hanzi: 医生说不能随便服用镇静剂。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō bù néng suíbiàn fúyòng zhènjìngjì.
examples.english: The doctor said sedatives must not be taken casually.

examples.hanzi: 我哥哥是一名大学生，在北京读书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge shì yì míng dàxuéshēng, zài Běijīng dúshū.
examples.english: My older brother is a university student studying in Beijing.

examples.hanzi: 很多大学生暑假会去打工。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō dàxuéshēng shǔjià huì qù dǎgōng.
examples.english: Many college students take part-time jobs in the summer.

examples.hanzi: 这种药吃下去很快就奏效。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào chī xiàqù hěn kuài jiù zòuxiào.
examples.english: This medicine takes effect soon after being taken.

examples.hanzi: 他的办法没有奏效，问题还是没解决。
examples.pinyin: Tā de bànfǎ méiyǒu zòuxiào, wèntí háishi méi jiějué.
examples.english: His method didn't work, and the problem still isn't solved.

examples.hanzi: 吸烟会危害健康。
examples.pinyin: Xīyān huì wēihài jiànkāng.
examples.english: Smoking harms your health.

examples.hanzi: 这些害虫危害了农田里的庄稼。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē hàichóng wēihài le nóngtián lǐ de zhuāngjia.
examples.english: These pests damaged the crops in the fields.

examples.hanzi: 我不知道是什么缘故，他今天没来。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào shì shénme yuángù, tā jīntiān méi lái.
examples.english: I don't know the reason, but he didn't come today.

examples.hanzi: 他是因为生病的缘故才请假的。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yīnwèi shēngbìng de yuángù cái qǐngjià de.
examples.english: He took leave because of being sick.

examples.hanzi: 你先走，我随后跟随你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān zǒu, wǒ suíhòu gēnsuí nǐ.
examples.english: You go first; I will follow you later.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们跟随老师参观了博物馆。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen gēnsuí lǎoshī cānguān le bówùguǎn.
examples.english: The children visited the museum following their teacher.

examples.hanzi: 爸爸夸奖我这次考试考得好。
examples.pinyin: Bàba kuājiǎng wǒ zhè cì kǎoshì kǎo de hǎo.
examples.english: Dad praised me for doing well on this exam.

examples.hanzi: 大家都夸奖这位厨师的手艺。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu kuājiǎng zhè wèi chúshī de shǒuyì.
examples.english: Everyone praised this chef's cooking.

examples.hanzi: 这家医院正在招募志愿者。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn zhèngzài zhāomù zhìyuànzhě.
examples.english: This hospital is recruiting volunteers.

examples.hanzi: 我周末去养老院当志愿者。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò qù yǎnglǎoyuàn dāng zhìyuànzhě.
examples.english: On weekends I volunteer at a nursing home.

examples.hanzi: 烟里含有很多有害的毒素。
examples.pinyin: Yān lǐ hányǒu hěn duō yǒuhài de dúsù.
examples.english: Cigarettes contain a lot of harmful toxins.

examples.hanzi: 多喝水可以帮助排出毒素。
examples.pinyin: Duō hē shuǐ kěyǐ bāngzhù páichū dúsù.
examples.english: Drinking more water can help flush out toxins.

examples.hanzi: 我的铅笔断了，你有削笔刀吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiānbǐ duàn le, nǐ yǒu xiāobǐdāo ma?
examples.english: My pencil broke; do you have a sharpener?

examples.hanzi: 他喜欢用铅笔画素描。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan yòng qiānbǐ huà sùmiáo.
examples.english: He likes drawing sketches with a pencil.

examples.hanzi: 我们在山脚下会合，然后一起上山。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài shānjiǎo xià huìhé, ránhòu yìqǐ shàngshān.
examples.english: We'll meet at the foot of the mountain and then climb together.

examples.hanzi: 两条河在这里会合。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng tiáo hé zài zhèlǐ huìhé.
examples.english: The two rivers join here.

examples.hanzi: 刚出炉的面包闻起来很诱人。
examples.pinyin: Gāng chūlú de miànbāo wén qǐlái hěn yòurén.
examples.english: Freshly baked bread smells very tempting.

examples.hanzi: 他们提出了一个非常诱人的条件。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen tíchū le yí gè fēicháng yòurén de tiáojiàn.
examples.english: They put forward a very attractive offer.

examples.hanzi: 这是一种非常罕见的疾病。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yì zhǒng fēicháng hǎnjiàn de jíbìng.
examples.english: This is a very rare disease.

examples.hanzi: 这么大的雪在南方很罕见。
examples.pinyin: Zhème dà de xuě zài nánfāng hěn hǎnjiàn.
examples.english: Snow this heavy is rare in the south.

examples.hanzi: 他们在森林里狩猎野兔。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài sēnlín lǐ shòuliè yětù.
examples.english: They hunt hares in the forest.

examples.hanzi: 这个地区禁止狩猎。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū jìnzhǐ shòuliè.
examples.english: Hunting is banned in this area.

examples.hanzi: 他拉开抽屉，找出一把钥匙。
examples.pinyin: Tā lākāi chōuti, zhǎochū yì bǎ yàoshi.
examples.english: He pulled open the drawer and found a key.

examples.hanzi: 请把两把椅子拉开一点。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ liǎng bǎ yǐzi lākāi yìdiǎn.
examples.english: Please pull the two chairs a bit apart.

examples.hanzi: 这件事就此结束，大家别再争论了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì jiùcǐ jiéshù, dàjiā bié zài zhēnglùn le.
examples.english: Let's end this matter here; stop arguing, everyone.

examples.hanzi: 我们就此告别，希望以后再见。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiùcǐ gàobié, xīwàng yǐhòu zài jiàn.
examples.english: We say goodbye here, hoping to meet again.

examples.hanzi: 我把书包放在了车的后座上。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ shūbāo fàng zài le chē de hòuzuò shàng.
examples.english: I put my school bag on the back seat of the car.

examples.hanzi: 后座的乘客也要系安全带。
examples.pinyin: Hòuzuò de chéngkè yě yào jì ānquándài.
examples.english: Passengers in the back seat must also wear seat belts.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们在水中玩得很开心。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài shuǐzhōng wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: The children are having great fun playing in the water.

examples.hanzi: 他在水中憋了一分钟的气。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài shuǐzhōng biē le yì fēnzhōng de qì.
examples.english: He held his breath underwater for one minute.

examples.hanzi: 我们希望过上安宁的生活。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xīwàng guò shàng ānníng de shēnghuó.
examples.english: We hope to live a peaceful life.

examples.hanzi: 夜深了，四周十分安宁。
examples.pinyin: Yè shēn le, sìzhōu shífēn ānníng.
examples.english: It was late at night, and it was very quiet all around.

examples.hanzi: 别为难他，他也不容易。
examples.pinyin: Bié wéinán tā, tā yě bù róngyì.
examples.english: Don't make things hard for him; it's not easy for him either.

examples.hanzi: 你这样问，让我很为难。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhèyàng wèn, ràng wǒ hěn wéinán.
examples.english: You're putting me in a difficult position by asking that.

examples.hanzi: 这里的环境十分恶劣，几乎没有人住。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de huánjìng shífēn èliè, jīhū méiyǒu rén zhù.
examples.english: The environment here is very harsh, and almost nobody lives here.

examples.hanzi: 他的态度恶劣，让客人很生气。
examples.pinyin: Tā de tàidù èliè, ràng kèrén hěn shēngqì.
examples.english: His attitude was bad and made the customer angry.

examples.hanzi: 他们决定炸掉那座老桥。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen juédìng zhàdiào nà zuò lǎo qiáo.
examples.english: They decided to blow up that old bridge.

examples.hanzi: 油太热了，把锅都炸掉了一块漆。
examples.pinyin: Yóu tài rè le, bǎ guō dōu zhàdiào le yí kuài qī.
examples.english: The oil was so hot that it blew a patch of paint off the pan.

examples.hanzi: 每天早上，国旗准时升起。
examples.pinyin: Měi tiān zǎoshang, guóqí zhǔnshí shēngqǐ.
examples.english: Every morning the national flag rises on time.

examples.hanzi: 一轮明月从海面上升起。
examples.pinyin: Yì lún míngyuè cóng hǎimiàn shàng shēngqǐ.
examples.english: A bright moon rose from the surface of the sea.

examples.hanzi: 这条铁路已经使用了一百年。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo tiělù yǐjīng shǐyòng le yìbǎi nián.
examples.english: This railway has been in use for a hundred years.

examples.hanzi: 他们在铁路旁边盖了一座房子。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài tiělù pángbiān gài le yí zuò fángzi.
examples.english: They built a house next to the railway.

examples.hanzi: 他眨眼就把东西吃光了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǎyǎn jiù bǎ dōngxi chī guāng le.
examples.english: He finished the food in the blink of an eye.

examples.hanzi: 她向我眨眼，让我别说话。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng wǒ zhǎyǎn, ràng wǒ bié shuōhuà.
examples.english: She winked at me, telling me not to talk.

examples.hanzi: 这个老头子很会讲故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lǎotóuzi hěn huì jiǎng gùshi.
examples.english: This old man is good at telling stories.

examples.hanzi: 我家那个老头子最爱下象棋。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā nàge lǎotóuzi zuì ài xià xiàngqí.
examples.english: My old man at home loves playing Chinese chess the most.

examples.hanzi: 鱼儿一上钩，他就赶紧拉线。
examples.pinyin: Yúr yí shànggōu, tā jiù gǎnjǐn lā xiàn.
examples.english: As soon as the fish bit, he quickly pulled the line.

examples.hanzi: 骗子的话你别信，不然你会上钩的。
examples.pinyin: Piànzi de huà nǐ bié xìn, bùrán nǐ huì shànggōu de.
examples.english: Don't believe the con man's words, or you'll take the bait.

examples.hanzi: 孩子喜欢玩一千块的拼图。
examples.pinyin: Háizi xǐhuan wán yì qiān kuài de pīntú.
examples.english: The child likes playing with thousand-piece puzzles.

examples.hanzi: 她用拼图拼出了一幅世界地图。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng pīntú pīn chū le yì fú shìjiè dìtú.
examples.english: She put together a world map with a jigsaw puzzle.

examples.hanzi: 他说话算话，一定会兑现诺言。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà suànhuà, yídìng huì duìxiàn nuòyán.
examples.english: He keeps his word and will definitely fulfill his promise.

examples.hanzi: 这张支票可以到银行兑现。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhīpiào kěyǐ dào yínháng duìxiàn.
examples.english: This check can be cashed at the bank.

examples.hanzi: 起初我们都不习惯这里的天气。
examples.pinyin: Qǐchū wǒmen dōu bù xíguàn zhèlǐ de tiānqì.
examples.english: At first we were all not used to the weather here.

examples.hanzi: 起初他很害羞，后来慢慢开朗了。
examples.pinyin: Qǐchū tā hěn hàixiū, hòulái mànmàn kāilǎng le.
examples.english: At first he was shy, but later he gradually became cheerful.

examples.hanzi: 那位政治家曾经遭到刺杀，但幸运地活了下来。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi zhèngzhìjiā céngjīng zāodào cìshā, dàn xìngyùn de huó le xiàlái.
examples.english: That politician was once the target of an assassination attempt but luckily survived.

examples.hanzi: 这部电影讲的是一场刺杀国王的计划。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎng de shì yì chǎng cìshā guówáng de jìhuà.
examples.english: This movie is about a plot to assassinate a king.

examples.hanzi: 火车会在上海停留十分钟。
examples.pinyin: Huǒchē huì zài Shànghǎi tíngliú shí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: The train will stop in Shanghai for ten minutes.

examples.hanzi: 请不要在门口停留，会挡住别人。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng búyào zài ménkǒu tíngliú, huì dǎngzhù biérén.
examples.english: Please don't linger at the door; you'll block others.

examples.hanzi: 明天上午十点我们在公司门口碰面。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān shàngwǔ shí diǎn wǒmen zài gōngsī ménkǒu pèngmiàn.
examples.english: Tomorrow at ten in the morning we'll meet at the company entrance.

examples.hanzi: 好久没见了，找个时间碰面聊聊吧。
examples.pinyin: Hǎojiǔ méi jiàn le, zhǎo gè shíjiān pèngmiàn liáoliao ba.
examples.english: It's been a while; let's find some time to meet and chat.

examples.hanzi: 运动员们听到“各就各位”，都蹲了下来。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòngyuánmen tīngdào "gèjiù-gèwèi", dōu dūn le xiàlái.
examples.english: The athletes crouched down when they heard "take your marks".

examples.hanzi: 演出快开始了，大家各就各位。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnchū kuài kāishǐ le, dàjiā gèjiù-gèwèi.
examples.english: The show is about to start, so everyone take your positions.

examples.hanzi: 我们两个人很有默契，不用多说。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen liǎng gè rén hěn yǒu mòqì, búyòng duō shuō.
examples.english: The two of us have a tacit understanding and don't need to say much.

examples.hanzi: 他们在比赛中配合得很默契。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài bǐsài zhōng pèihé de hěn mòqì.
examples.english: They cooperated with great chemistry in the game.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们在草地上追逐打闹。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài cǎodì shàng zhuīzhú dǎnào.
examples.english: The children chase and play around on the grass.

examples.hanzi: 他一生都在追逐自己的梦想。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìshēng dōu zài zhuīzhú zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: He pursued his dream all his life.

examples.hanzi: 陆军和海军一起进行了训练。
examples.pinyin: Lùjūn hé hǎijūn yìqǐ jìnxíng le xùnliàn.
examples.english: The army and the navy trained together.

examples.hanzi: 他在陆军服役了五年。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài lùjūn fúyì le wǔ nián.
examples.english: He served in the army for five years.
